lines.scene: Three of us. Count again if you like.
Sacred bone, and the men are gone from it.
Dukman, don't start with the stars.
I already started. They're ruder than ministers.
Seungman will count the grain. Let her.
Someone should. Stars don't fill a bowl.
Chunmyung spent her claim on a boy.
A throne traded is still a choice. I said it.

lines.text: 다가설 수 없는 너를 나에게 너를 보여줘
lines.scene: And we are what's left in the room.
Last three women who can wear the rank
without borrowing a husband's bone.

lines.text: 내에게 너를 맞춰가고 있다 말하지 마
lines.scene: I won't survive by being sweet.
I'll survive by seeing the sky they ignore.
I'll survive by not pretending I ruled
more than the hours I was given.
I'll survive by making a king
and not apologizing for the shape of it.
They will say a woman cannot.

lines.text: 다가설 수 없는 너를 내게 보여줘
lines.scene: Let them say it into our sleeves.

lines.text: 어둠 속의 한 줄기 빛처럼 느껴, my love
lines.scene: Dukman laughs too brightly. On purpose.

lines.text: 사랑하는 너를 모두 느낄 수 있어
lines.scene: Seungman pours. On purpose.
I keep the box with the pin in it. On purpose.
We are not a chorus. We are a house.
If one of us falls, the rank does not.
That is the only invitation that matters.
Come in. Sit. We are still here.
Not asking. Telling the century.
Three princesses. One bone.

lines.text: 내에게 너를 맞춰가고 있다 말하지 마
lines.scene: Watch us outlast the slogan.
Dukman stays bright.
Seungman stays.
